people.description: Fictional adult woman, about 60, deep brown skin, short silver curls, blue linen shirt, deliberate movements.
Fictional adult man, about 35, light olive skin, straight dark chin-length hair, charcoal cardigan, reserved manner.
Fictional adult woman, about 45, pale freckled skin, auburn braid, moss-green jacket, attentive manner.
Fictional adult man, about 50, medium brown skin, closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair, rust cotton shirt, patient manner.

settings.description: Small sunlit apartment, wooden table beside one window, muted cream walls.
Quiet evening cafe counter, warm side light, plain ceramic cups, no signage.
Sheltered rooftop at dusk, simple bench, warm practical lamp, no visible signs.
Shaded courtyard, stone table, potted greenery, soft afternoon light.
One uncluttered artist loft: pale timber floor, brick wall, plain stool, blank canvas and closed sketchbook; the same window and brickwork throughout.
One modern building lobby: beige stone floor, walnut wall panels, plain bench left, tall plant right; the same doorway and wall geometry throughout.
One empty covered market aisle: stone paving, timber stall, plain basket and folded cloth; the same canopy and stall throughout.
One quiet office: pale oak desk, cream walls, window left, plain chair, closed notebook and unbranded desk lamp; the same desk layout throughout.
One enclosed garden: stone path, low green hedge left, timber bench right, terracotta pot; the same plants, path and bench throughout.
One sheltered house porch: pale timber floor, cream exterior wall, simple chair left, small side table and plant right; the same doorway throughout.
One sheltered lakeside deck: timber boards, low railing, plain chair and side table; the same distant shoreline throughout.
A quiet residential street: pale stone paving, brick wall left, plain bench right, one potted tree; the same facades and pavement throughout.
One quiet reading room: walnut shelves, cream walls, simple chair, closed book and side table; the same shelf arrangement throughout.
One quiet pedestrian bus shelter: clear glass panels, plain bench and small unmarked bag; the same paving and glass frame throughout.
One enclosed home balcony: tiled floor, solid parapet, plain chair and potted fern; the same doorway and tile pattern throughout.
One small craft workshop: worn oak table, pale plaster wall, plain stool, closed wooden box and folded cloth; the same table and wall throughout.
